newsitem.title: USA: MoneyGram, Thomas Cook form joint venture.
newsitem.headline: MoneyGram, Thomas Cook form joint venture.

text.p: MoneyGram Payment Systems Inc and Thomas Cook said Thursday they have formed MoneyGram International Ltd, a joint venture.
The new company will expand the distribution of MoneyGram's quick cash transfer services in key markets in western Europe, Africa, the Middle East and Asia, the two companies said.
MoneyGram owns a 51 percent stake in the London-based company; Thomas Cook, a travel and financial services concern, will hold the remaining 49 percent, they said.
James Calvano, chairman and chief executive officer of MoneyGram, said the joint venture "moves us three to five years forward in development of these key markets."
MoneyGram services are currently available in 85 countries through 18,500 locations, including neaerly 600 Thomas Cook worldwide outlets.
Thomas Cook became a large contract agent of MoneyGram over the last few months.
The new joint venture will expand Thomas Cook's portfolio of financial service products and distribution channels, said John Donaldson, a managing director of the company.
Thomas Cook provides services in more than 3,000 locations in more than 100 countries.
